subject: Post-demo security handoff — request for pen test report & vuln SLA
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@healthstack.io>, Rajiv Shah <rajiv@healthstack.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security handoff — request for pen test report & vuln SLA

Hi Emily / Rajiv,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through HealthStack's integration patterns and data flows. As discussed on the call, the security and compliance folks on our side want a couple of concrete artifacts to finish qualification and scope the next steps for Dedicated deployment. Below is a concise list of asks and proposed timelines so we can keep momentum:  

- SOC 2: Are you SOC 2 Type II certified today, or is there a report in-flight? If you have an executive summary or report we can review, please share.
- GDPR / HIPAA: high-level statement on processing locations and whether you sign BAAs.
- Pen test: would you be able to share the latest external penetration test report (redacted as needed)? If there's a vendor NDA required before handoff, point us to the DocuSign link and we'll push it internally.
- Vulnerability management: brief outline of SLAs for critical/high/medium findings and the cadence of external scans. For example, what is your target remediation window for critical defects?

Proposed next steps:  
1) If you can share SOC 2 exec summary + redacted pen report (or DocuSign for the full report), we'll coordinate a short security review (30 min) with our security engineer.  
2) We'll send back our vendor questionnaire (attached) — can you confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire?  
3) If both sides agree to an NDA for sensitive artifacts, we can schedule the review for next week.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (vendor questionnaire template)

Thanks — assigning owners below so there’s clarity: Aditya (technical qualification), Marissa (security onboarding).

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachment: redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Emily Park <epark@healthstack.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@healthstack.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security handoff — request for pen test report & vuln SLA

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the clear recap. Looping in Rajiv (security) to handle the artifacts. Quick answers up front:  

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II last quarter; attaching the executive summary. We can share the full report under a mutual NDA.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We process EU data in EU regions only; we are willing to sign BAAs for covered workflows — our legal team confirms standard BAA terms.
- Pen test: We ran an external pentest on 2027-09-15 (third-party vendor). We have a redacted copy available for initial review; the full report requires an NDA.
- Vulnerability management: We run internal scans weekly and engage an external vendor quarterly. Our current target SLAs are: Critical — 30 days; High — 60 days; Medium — 120 days (exceptions handled per mutual risk assessment).

Attachments: healthstack_soc2_executive_summary.pdf, prelim_pen_test_results_redacted.pdf

Rajiv, can you confirm whether the DocuSign link for the NDA below is OK for full report handoff? Also, Marissa/Aditya — let us know if the SLA above aligns with Redwood expectations or if you'd prefer tighter windows for critical items.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Director, Platform Security, HealthStack
epark@healthstack.io

[Attachment: healthstack_soc2_executive_summary.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: prelim_pen_test_results_redacted.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@healthstack.io>, Rajiv Shah <rajiv@healthstack.io>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security handoff — request for pen test report & vuln SLA

Thanks Emily — appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A few internal notes and asks from the Redwood security side:  

1) NDA: we typically sign a mutual NDA before receiving full pen reports. If you can share the DocuSign link, we'll route it to Legal. For initial triage the redacted PDF is fine.

2) Redaction & evidence: when you provide the full report, please redact any customer-identifying data. Additionally, if possible, include a remediation status table (finding, affected component, severity, remediation owner, current status). That helps our SecOps team accelerate triage.

3) SLA alignment: the SLA numbers you shared are acceptable as a starting point. For critical findings we prefer a 14–30 day window depending on exploitability and customer impact; would you be open to committing to 30 days for crit and 45 days for high as a cross-company target for customers on Dedicated?

4) Scanning cadence: quarterly external + weekly internal is good. Can you confirm whether external scans include authenticated checks (yes/no) and whether you run container image scans as part of the pipeline?

Next actions (owners):
- Emily / Rajiv: send DocuSign NDA link so Legal can review (Emily)
- HealthStack: confirm whether external scans are authenticated and container scans are included (Rajiv)
- Redwood (Aditya): share a short handoff template we use for pen reports (will attach after legal review)

I'll hold off on scheduling the security review until we have the NDA sign-off.

-Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

[Attachment: (will provide Redwood pen-handoff template after NDA)]

From: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@healthstack.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <epark@healthstack.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security handoff — request for pen test report & vuln SLA

Hi all — thanks for the notes. A couple quick items from HealthStack security:  

- DocuSign NDA: here is the link for our mutual exchange — https://docusign.example.com/sign/HSK-30924 (please sign and send back; once countersigned we’ll push the full pen report).
- Redaction: we can provide a redacted report for initial triage. For the full report we will remove any customer-identifying information and IP-level screenshots as needed.
- External scans: our quarterly external assessments include authenticated checks (scoped credentials) for the public-facing API surface; we also run SCA/image scanning in CI for our container images.
- SLA: we can commit to 30 days for Critical and 60 days for High for customers on Dedicated. If you need an accelerated SLA for critical items tied to go-live, we can document that in the mutual action plan.

Action items:  
1) HealthStack to send NDA (Emily/Rajiv) — DONE (DocuSign link above)
2) Redwood to route NDA to Legal and confirm sign-off (Jasmine)
3) After NDA: HealthStack to provide full report (redacted per agreement) + remediation tracker
4) Schedule 30-minute security review the week after NDA is signed (Proposed slots attached)

Regards,
Rajiv Shah
Head of Security Engineering, HealthStack
rajiv@healthstack.io

[Attachment: (redacted report already shared)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Shah <rajiv@healthstack.io>, Emily Park <epark@healthstack.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@healthstack.io
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security handoff — request for pen test report & vuln SLA

Perfect — thanks Rajiv, Emily. We’ll get the NDA into Legal right away. Quick confirmation of next steps from Redwood:  

- Jasmine to send NDA to Redwood Legal (today) and confirm when countersigned.
- Aditya to prepare our pen-handoff template and prepopulate the initial triage checklist.
- Marissa to set up the 30-minute security review; propose next Tue/Wed morning PT — will send calendar invite once NDA is confirmed.

Thanks again for the quick turn. If you prefer, I can also share Redwood's standard vulnerability SLA proposal (we typically propose Critical: 30 days, High: 45 days, Medium: 90 days) so we have a single doc to negotiate.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Inline attachments referenced above: redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx; healthstack_soc2_executive_summary.pdf; prelim_pen_test_results_redacted.pdf]
